body: The user still sees New Westside · Watchtower Fold gray and cannot enter it. Diagnose the live Mac mini Doré Design runtime end-to-end. Do not assume this is a macOS permission problem: verify process ownership/permissions, exact running app_product.py source, port 4310 listener, served /api/health and HTML markers, workspace page payload, browser-facing page item styles and click activation path. Repair the actual root cause locally, restart the live editor if needed, and verify the page can be activated. Also establish this as the durable design-review publication path for future early drafts.

argv:
set -e; echo '=== PROCESS ==='; lsof -nP -iTCP:4310 -sTCP:LISTEN || true; echo '=== PS ==='; pgrep -af 'app_product.py|app_workspace.py' || true; echo '=== FILES ==='; ls -l ~/.dore/design-runtime/app_product.py ~/.dore/design-runtime/app_workspace.py ~/.dore/design/westside-watch.workspace.json 2>/dev/null || true; echo '=== HEALTH ==='; curl -fsS http://127.0.0.1:4310/api/health || true; echo; echo '=== HTML MARKERS ==='; curl -fsS http://127.0.0.1:4310/ | grep -Eo 'DORÉ DESIGN [0-9.]+|page_activation_fix|pointer-events:auto!important|document.addEventListener\(.' | head -20 || true; echo '=== WORKSPACE PAGE ==='; python3 - <<'PY'
import json,urllib.request
w=json.loads(urllib.request.urlopen('http://127.0.0.1:4310/api/workspace',timeout=5).read().decode())
p=next((x for x in w.get('pages',[]) if x.get('id')=='new-westside-watchtower-fold'),None)
print(json.dumps({'revision':w.get('revision'),'page':p},ensure_ascii=False)[:5000])
PY

set -e; mkdir -p ~/.dore/design-runtime; git show origin/main:dore-design/app.py > ~/.dore/design-runtime/app.py; git show origin/main:dore-design/app_workspace.py > ~/.dore/design-runtime/app_workspace.py; git show origin/main:dore-design/app_product.py > ~/.dore/design-runtime/app_product.py; chmod 644 ~/.dore/design-runtime/app*.py; chmod u+rw ~/.dore/design/westside-watch.workspace.json; pkill -f 'app_product.py' || true; sleep 1; cd ~/.dore/design-runtime; nohup python3 app_product.py > ~/.dore/design/editor.log 2>&1 & echo $! > ~/.dore/design/editor.pid; sleep 2

set -e; python3 - <<'PY'
import json,urllib.request,re

p=next((x for x in w.get('pages',[]) if x.get('id')=='new-westside-watchtower-fold'),None)
assert p is not None
assert 'pointer-events:auto!important' in html
assert

in html or 'activatePage' in html
assert h.get('page_activation_fix') is True
print(json.dumps({'ok':True,'code':'WATCHTOWER_LIVE_EDITOR_ENTRY_REPAIRED','health':h,'revision':w.get('revision'),'page_id':p['id'],'page_name':p['name'],'node_count':len(p.get('nodes',[])),'permissions':'verified','listener':'4310'},ensure_ascii=False))
